pr.title: Project Radius backing resource connections from recipe outputs, and upgrade to Radius 0.60
pr.author: nellshamrell

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Test teardown fails with EBUSY: resource busy or locked when removing a Windows temp workspace directory. The PR only modifies Aspire.Hosting.Radius source and tests, none of which touch the VS Code extension or its E2E test fixtures. This exact EBUSY rmdir failure at fixtures.js:217:15 matches a well-known recurring flaky pattern on this Windows E2E shard (23+ prior occurrences), caused by a file handle still held (e.g. by antivirus, indexing, or a lingering child process) when the test harness attempts to delete the temp workspace directory.
